rationale: The agent proceeded to submit an exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm before any write. There is also no clear evidence of user authentication prior to acting (e.g., via find_user_id_by_name_zip) shown in the conversation. While the thermostat exchange aligns with the user’s conditional request and the agent provided refund details and next steps, the lack of confirmation and missing/unclear authentication cause the interaction to fail the pass bar. Additionally, the agent did not present or confirm availability of a suitable clicky, RGB, full-size keyboard before deciding not to exchange it, further reducing confidence in proper handling.
